tom_tat: The Dharma Ending Age is the time when "Dharma's strength is weak," the power of demons becomes stronger and stronger, and Buddha's power becomes more and more narrow. Buddha did not focus on power but on dignity. When the blessings of sentient beings are still great...
noi_dung:
27. EXCELLENT DEMONS

(Van Buddha Thanh September 30, 1982)

The Dharma Ending Age is the time when "Dharma is strong and evil is weak," The demon's power is getting stronger and stronger, Buddha's power is getting narrower. Buddha did not focus on power but on dignity. When the blessings of sentient beings are still great, then "the Dharma is strong and the devil is weak"; When the blessings of sentient beings are few, "Dharma is strong and the Dharma is weak."

Currently, the entire human race is like a mountain made up of many small eggs. If one egg breaks, the whole mountain of eggs will collapse. So human life is truly threatened. That's why we see the devil and his followers everywhere.

When the truth is spoken, no one listens, but when the evil is spoken, how many people believe it? Like when preaching the Sutra and preaching the Dharma, although there were people who came to listen, they came very reluctantly, not really happy to listen; But when it comes to listening to singing, going to the movies, going to dances, let's compete, thinking it's the best, the best thing. You can see: People's hearts are no longer the same, morality has degenerated! This shows that the demon king used his power and "magical powers". to disturb the world!

Currently the biggest monster is the computer. After this machine was invented, humans became waste, no longer had any use because the brain machine could solve all problems. Electroencephalography makes people numb and no longer benevolent; also makes people become sentimental, no longer excited, and unable to understand everything thoroughly, like

"born in a drunken state, die in a dream." So if the brain is not a ghost, then what is it? This magic is created by the intelligence of demons.

Another monster is television (T.V.), a product that makes people so fascinated that they cannot distinguish between black and white, right and wrong. T.V. Teaching children to do crazy things, how to kill people, burn houses, steal, rape, and smoke drugs. That's all due to the influence of T.V. that came out. So electroencephalogram and T.V. are two monsters. Even though it is a monster, people do not understand it clearly and consider it a precious thing, so they spend a large amount of money to buy it and use it.

There is another monster, which is a satellite rocket. Because this type of satellite is shot into the air, it can guide atomic warheads, hydrogen or laser beams to kill people. Laser (called purple light in Chinese) is a very bad word, because "death light" meaning light kills. This is also something invented by the devil to destroy humanity. In addition, people also use every method to help this monster, releasing all kinds of toxic gases to pollute people, making them lost in a maze, making east, west, south, and north no longer distinguishable. That is all caused by the power of these ghosts.

Currently, there is a kind of ghost from outer space who wants to destroy the world, with every trick to destroy humanity. They release toxic gas. Whenever they hit grain or rice, the person who eats it will be poisoned; If it hits an animal, the person who eats it will also be poisoned. Whenever people eat fish or seafood, they will be poisoned, develop all kinds of cancer and die.

These ghosts also use slow-acting poisons, smeared on objects they use every day, such as toilet paper. Toilet paper has a very fragrant smell that makes people love to use it, but it is extremely harmful, because it causes cancer or other diseases. In the past, people didn't use fragrant toilet paper and there weren't as many strange diseases as there are now!

But the most dangerous poison is paper money that no one can throw away. There is a poisonous substance on paper money, if people touch it, they will be born with the disease of greed; So much so that everything requires a lot of money. Whether it's eating, living, working, whatever it is, you want as much money as possible; so just find ways to make money. When your mind always thinks about money, cancer will arise, and nothing can cure this poison.

In the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, because there are all Buddhas in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, we can be far away from that toxic energy. Those who study Buddha here must not fight, not be greedy, not seek, not be selfish, not take personal advantage, not lie, then they will not be poisoned by money.

If you don't eat meat and are only vegetarian, the poison in meat won't be able to penetrate your body. Fasting from natural plants, it has the power to detoxify. So no matter what kind of poison a demon or demon releases, if you fast for a period of time, that poison will naturally dissolve; Therefore, vegetarianism is the best method to maintain health and longevity.

I've told you what I've told you today. Next, please think about it and see if you've made any mistakes. If so, quickly change them.

Don't fight, be greedy, seek, be selfish, take personal advantage, or lie. If you get rid of those six bad habits, you can't be poisoned!

The most important thing is to clean up your own trash. Wipe away hatred, resentment, anger, anger, and sadness. Whoever still has the above impurities in his heart, the trash in his heart has not yet been cleared away. If your mind is clean, it naturally won't hate anyone, won't resent anyone, won't give rise to worry, sadness, trouble, won't get angry, and won't bother anyone at all.

Every disciple who takes refuge in me, regardless of whether he is leaving the home life or leaving the home life, and truly believes in me, must know how to improve his habit of mistakes. We must empty the trash bin in our minds, so that in this Dharma Ending era we can radiate light to make the world brighter. This world will sooner or later be destroyed, but if there are people who truly practice, the world will increase righteous energy and reduce evil energy; Buddha's power will be stronger, demon's power will be weaker.

Don't consider my words as the wind blowing through your ears, because it is very important and practically related to the current issue!

tieu_de: 28. Dharma Realm ONLY MIND CREATION
tom_tat: There are many different species of living beings in the world. Each Buddha has his own relatives; Each relative has countless different species. Bodhisattva, Pratyekabuddha, Sravaka are the same. Those are the four Dharmas...
noi_dung:
28. Dharma Realm ONLY MIND CREATION

(Van Buddha Thanh October 2, 1982)

There are many different species of living beings in the world. Each Buddha has his own relatives; Each relative has countless different species. Bodhisattva, Pratyekabuddha, Sravaka are the same. Those are the four Dharma Realms of the Saints and Sages.

As ordinary people, the difference between us and the Saints is very far, it is difficult to express their level and wisdom.

Currently talking about the six Dharma Realms of mortals, the one above is the Dharma Realm of Heavenly beings. Heaven also has all kinds of disagreements. Heaven, plus Asura and Humans, are the three Good Paths. The Three Evil Paths are Hell, Hungry Ghosts, and Animals; Each of these things has all kinds of kinship with all kinds of different divine beings. Within each type, there are many different types. Where do the Ten Dharma Realms come from? They come from one of your current thoughts (present one thought)! The mind can create the Dharma Realm, the mind can create all things, the mind can create all kinds of forms and all kinds of things: Necessarily idealistic creation. (Everything is created by the mind.) Again:

"Weakness of human desire will understand,

Three worlds necessarily Buddha,

Bodhisattva of all three worlds,

Sravakas of the Three Worlds,

Three Worlds of Gods,

Great, Immortal, Human,

Asura race,

Race of animal beings,

The race of hungry ghosts,

Race of the Hells,

Contemplating the nature of the Dharmadhatu,

Necessarily idealistic creation."

Meaning:

"If you want to know clearly,

All three generations of Buddhas,

Bodhisattva Bodhisattva of three generations,

Three generations of Sravakas,

Three generations of Gods,

The Great Immortal with him,

Types of Asuras,

Innumerable kinds of animal beings,

Countless types of Hungry Ghosts,

Countless layers of Hell,

Should contemplate the nature of the Dharma Realm,

Everything is created by the mind."

The mind can create Heaven, create Hell. The mind can make you a Buddha, the mind can make you a Hungry Ghost, an Animal, a Hell, a Bodhisattva, a Sravaka. Because everything is created by the mind, everything is only in this mind. If your mind wants to become a Buddha, then the Buddha Dharma Realm is your relative. The remaining Dharma Realms are the same!

Everything does not leave this mind, because this mind creates everything; So please pay attention: When walking, standing, lying down, sitting, you must always know how to "be polite" (Subjugate yourself in a proper manner). I only do things that are truthful, not things that are fake, careless or scandalous; Must avoid situations: Just the first cause before the waterfall, Thuy willow full table flag. (If you make just one wrong move, you lose the whole game.)

To create Buddha's Dharma Realm, one must have Loving-kindness, Compassion, Joy, and Equanimity; knowing the benefit of sentient beings, but not being attached to the fact that there are sentient beings. Don't use superficial efforts and practice superficially; You have to really work hard step by step.

Why do I want to create the Dharma Realm of all Buddhas? What if the creation doesn't finish?" It's only because our thoughts are not single-minded, our will is not steadfast, we keep turning depending on fate and being led by the realm, so we forget everything: Forgetting that we must create Buddha, Bodhisattva, and the four Saints, so we only know how to create Hell, Hungry Ghosts, and Animals! So say: Reciting in motion all things that exist, Reciting all things that are pure and non-existent. (If the mind is moving, a hundred things exist, if the mind is pure, all things are empty.)

Again:

"The mind only recites perfectly: true wealth, desire is ended: Foot blessings filled!”Meaning:

"If thoughts cease, the mind stops, that is wealth,

If desires are cut off, only then will blessings be real!"

Someone asked: Why are ghosts not a Dharma Realm?

Answer: Demons are like bandits or guerrillas, always wandering in the four directions, without a certain country, and without a ruler. Robbers are human beings, but not all humans are robbers, so it is not said that the Dharma Realm belongs to robbers. This principle explains ghosts similarly.

There are also ghosts in the sky, there are also ghosts in Asura. The good part belongs to a dharma world, the not good part belongs to the demon world; Because demons change throughout the entire Luc Pham Dharma Realm, it can even transform, infect, and destroy the Four Holy Dharma Realms.

Buddha or ghost are all caused by a wrong thought. Buddha has a mind of compassion, while demons have a mind of fighting to win. Just like Devadatta, who had a very strong mind of victory, always wanted to fight with Buddha, but Buddha did not fight with him. Devadatta also had Buddha nature, but he accidentally took a wrong step, lost his way too deeply, could not turn back, so he fell into the demon world. According to the Mahayana spirit, Buddha, in order to teach and transform demons, also manifested himself as a demon to educate and transform demons. Demons spread throughout Luc Pham Dharma Realm, so there is no need to establish another dharma world. Although it pervades all dharma realms, it is fake, false, and not real. Just like in life, there is someone who conquers a mountain and calls himself King; Bandits also pretend to be the army, but wherever they go, they set fire to and kill people. Ghosts are similar!

29. LEARNING CREATES DESTINY

(Van Buddha Thanh October 7, 1982)

Lao Tzu said:

"A gentleman must learn to create his destiny,

Fate is caused by falling apart,

blessings autism bridge.

Painting, blessings beyond measure,

The only person who tricks himself."

Meaning:

"A gentleman has a way of creating destiny,

The destiny I made,

Blessings are my request.

Blessings and misfortunes have no door,

It's just my own inspiration."

"A gentleman learns to create his destiny." Heaven, Earth, and Man are called the Three Tai Tai. He is the representative of heaven and earth; The heavens cannot speak and the earth cannot speak either, only humans have words and movements. Human life is not certain, but it can also be said to be certain. Why definitely? Just like when we divide things: One part for you, one part for me; That's called certain. What is uncertain? Like your things, you use them up very quickly, but I don't use my things so they are still intact; That's called uncertainty. So say: "A gentleman has a way of learning how to create his destiny."

When I was born, no one called me to do evil, but I kept doing evil; That's me changing my own destiny. When you were born, no one told you to do good things, but if you keep doing good things, then you will escape your destiny. For example, if a pedestrian wants to go east, he should aim east. If he wants to go west, he should aim west. The destiny of a gentleman is very flexible and not rigid; Everything is done by our own hands, so: "A gentleman has a way of learning how to create his destiny."

"Destiny depends on failure." I can change my own destiny. If you know how to take care when you are sick, you will not end up in a life-threatening situation. That means having the ability to control yourself, not having to rely on others. Life and death should rotate in the Six Paths, but if you know how to practice the Path, you can escape destiny and cut off the cycle of birth and death; That's also called creating destiny.

"blessings autism bridge." Blessings from me that I ask for: If we know how to practice blessings, we will have blessings. If we know how to practice wisdom, we will have wisdom. blessings and wisdom together are even better.

Blessings must be sought within; Ask yourself to see if you are virtuous or not. If you have virtue, you will have blessings. If you are not virtuous, you will be without blessings. A gentleman seeks from himself, but a petty man seeks from others. Small people always look outside to pray.

"Pain, blessings beyond measure. The only person who tricks himself." Blessings and misfortunes have no entrance, they are only self-inflicted; means: Sick parts are imported, Painted parts are exported. (Disease enters from the mouth, Disaster comes out from the mouth.) People encounter all kinds of calamities and tribulations due to dirty talk. People who crave delicious food, fish, meat, chicken, duck, seafood, etc. Although it gives temporary pleasure, it will bring many diseases. When you eat it, it tastes delicious, but gradually when the poison seeps in and causes illness, there will be no cure! Currently, animal meat has a poison that no medicine can cure. So when we eat animal meat, that poison passes into our body. Plants are lifeless, so even if they are poisonous, they are very rare. The poison in meat is 100%, and the poison in vegetarian food is only 1%, so it can be said that eating meat and eating vegetarian are worlds apart!

Those who study Buddha Dharma should not be greedy for delicious food, do not be greedy for good taste! After a period of fasting, all the toxins in the body can be excreted without getting sick. I hope you will pay attention and study what I say. The current era is extremely bad, so everyone must boldly encourage each other not to kill, but to protect lives to avoid the disaster of humanity's destruction. Please be careful, and restrain yourself!

EATING MEAT IS JUST LIKE EATING POISON SO!

All living beings' meat is poisonous. This poison does not accumulate overnight, nor does it occur in just one lifetime. That poison accumulated over many lifetimes, from the mutual slaughter between people, has created a kind of resentment that cannot be erased.

When we kill animals, it also creates a kind of resentment in their minds; When they were about to die, because they were so terrified and scared, they developed hatred and wanted revenge. Therefore, from that resentment and anger, a toxin is released that permeates their skin, so whoever eats their meat is like eating poison! When you eat it, you don't feel any harm, but over time you'll get all sorts of strange diseases that no medicine can cure.

Nowadays, resentment is everywhere. That resentment is much more powerful than an atomic warhead, because it is invisible and formless but can destroy the entire human race.

There is a verse that says:

"Thousands of years of wandering,

Deep resentment comes from a sea of hatred and difficulty.

Desire to know the world's superior swords and warriors,

Ignore the disciples and sell your voice!"

Translated as:

"Thousands of years of resentment have filled the bowl of soup, Resentment is as deep as the ocean, hatred is difficult to dissolve. If you want to know why there is war, listen to the slaughterhouse at midnight!"

For hundreds of thousands of years, the piece of meat in the bowl of soup has contained resentment as deep as the ocean, which is difficult to level out. If you want to know the cause of war in the world, listen to the pitiful cries of the animals in the butcher's house at midnight. Therefore, the ancients who spoke this verse had a cause and a basis. We must thoroughly understand that principle to be able to cure our own illnesses.

31. CULTIVATING THE DAO DOES NOT BE NEGLIGENT!

People who practice the Way need to have a solid foundation and foundation. If you want to end life and death, you must have diligence. What does elaborate mean? That is, the way of things, the right mind, sincerity, and self-cultivation.

If you want to have a right mind, you must first understand the way things are. What is called object manner? The way is to eliminate selfish desires; Get rid of lust, get rid of bad thoughts, get rid of material desires. Material desires include money, lust, eating, drinking, sleeping, these things we need to completely eliminate, only then can we have a right mind.

Right mind means not being selfish; If you have a selfish mind, your mind cannot be right. Sincerity means that we are always like that; If you believe in Buddha, you will believe forever, believe forever; Believe with your true heart, believe with a very steadfast mind, without any doubt, for fear of suffering disadvantages and losses: "Well, I wonder if there is a Buddha or a Bodhisattva? How come I don't see them?" Thinking like that is similar to what a weasel thinks when walking on ice. On the ice, it tiptoed very carefully. When the ice broke a little, it immediately retreated. That's why the proverb says "like silver and ice" (like walking on thin ice) is like that. People who believe in Buddha should not have doubts or timidity as if falling into a deep abyss or walking on thin ice. We must have solid faith.

Self-cultivation means that we don't do anything that harms our body. Always have to be careful and careful, because: The body, the father, the husband, and the parents, are not sensitive to injury, but are filial and watery. (The body, hair, and skin come from parents, so do not dare to destroy or damage them. That is the beginning of filial piety.)

Cultivation requires the practice of "internal Saint, external King" (Inwardly like a saint, outwardly acting like a king). Inner Saint means the way of things, the right heart, the sincere intention. Cultivating one's self is the King's work, which means one must make merits: Need to work hard, No need to be active. (Diligence, working hard to do all kinds of things, Not afraid of more or less.) I do everything; cannot say: "I have to meditate every day to practice, I don't want to do anything else"; Because those who know how to practice can also practice while moving!

Practicing practice means the mind is always calm, without afflictions, without ignorance, without pride, jealousy, or obstacles. If the above mistakes are not eliminated, even if we meditate for eighty thousand eons, our anger, jealousy, and obstacles will still be inert and we cannot practice successfully. Therefore, practice requires genuine elimination of faulty habits and self-reflection; That is the attitude of a person who uses effort.

"The Airless Gentleman" It means that a gentleman is not like an object, like a tea cup can only be used to drink tea, a rice bowl can only hold food and cannot be used for other things. A gentleman must be both literate and martial, able to do both high and low things, only then can he rule the country and bring peace to the world: Sharpen your sword in battle, slaying the enemy. (Can swing a sword and rush into battle, chase away enemies and destroy enemies.)

Therefore, those who practice the Tao must strive diligently every day; Being diligent means practicing! The biggest disease when practicing is that the mind becomes troubled. If there is no affliction, then we will be free and liberated, then we are a great practitioner. The most important thing is that no matter what situation you are in, you must be very calm and calm, not causing trouble; That is the effective place of practice. Without creating afflictions, true wisdom can appear.

A gentleman can grow larger or shrink; When small, it is like a speck of dust, when large, it is like Mount Meru, like the entire Dharma Realm. A great man's will can stretch; Anyone who treats you unjustly will not be troubled, and can naturally stretch and stretch, sometimes square, sometimes round, sometimes straight. Therefore, a gentleman is not like an object. A gentleman does not rely on rules or authority, he does not follow rules. (A gentleman who is not formal does not have mighty virtue, nor is his education solid.)

If we don't control ourselves, we don't have dignity; The education is all fake. Therefore, a gentleman is not careless, laughs and jokes, and does not act recklessly. People who practice the Way need to surpass the gentleman. People who study Buddha practice like this every day, they cannot be lazy or contented!

tieu_de: 32. SOCIAL CHAOS
tom_tat: (Van Buddha City, July 1, 1982) "Ning is the dog of the times, not causing chaos in the world." Translate
noi_dung:
32. SOCIAL CHAOS

(Van Buddha Thanh July 1, 1982)"Ning is the dog of the times, not causing chaos in the world." Translated as:

"I'd rather be a dog in times of peace, than a human in times of chaos."

This saying says that being a dog in times of peace is better than being a human in times of chaos. In times of peace, there are no wars or chaos, nor are there any thieves or bandits; Therefore, the dog does not need to pay attention to guarding the door, it can comfortably sit and watch the house. However, during times of chaos, every house had iron bars and doors locked, and had to keep many dogs; Rich people hire gatekeepers. Even though the defense was strict, the people in the house were still extremely scared, as if they were walking on thin ice, or as if they were falling into an abyss.

In a world full of terror, being human doesn't mean much, so the ancients said: "Ning is the dog of the times, not causing chaos in the world!" Furthermore, most people in life like to be crazy, gossip, think what's right is wrong, think what's wrong is right. Filial piety is the righteous path that people must follow, but few people are willing to do it; On the contrary, if you are not filial and argue with your father and scold your mother, you will be considered to have strong character. You see, how chaotic is the world? Simply put: Humanity is no more! Look at the President (Ronald Reagan), a few years ago he was executed, shot several times, and the person next to him was also injured; But the perpetrator was found innocent by the court!

Assassinating the President without guilt is not encouraging others to break the law? Isn't that encouraging people to disregard the law? I really don't understand! But in short, it was a very unusual thing. If the perpetrator is not punished because he has a mental illness, then he should not be released so that he can roam free like he is now. Now he is automatically released and innocent. Isn't that strange?

Furthermore, recently in Cuu Kim Son, there were more than three hundred thousand homosexuals demonstrating their power. Those people, old, young, big, small, are all devilish demons that appear to cause trouble, making people crazy and confused, taking right for wrong, taking wrong for right, taking black for white, taking white for black. You see them as human beings, but in fact they are evil demons who came to this world to disturb the normal order of society. Furthermore, those without knowledge still consider their actions to be legal. Look, is it really pitiful? It's extremely chaotic!

This era is so pitiful! For those without knowledge, of course they cannot understand this. But if you have a heart for justice, then you will definitely suffer so much that you will cry and go on a hunger strike for three days!

noi_dung:
33. SIGNAL OF AMERICA'S INDIVIDUAL DAY

(Van Buddha Thanh at noon on July 4, 1982)

Today is America's Independence Day, commemorating the nation's founding. If the country has an anniversary, people also have an anniversary.

What is each person's anniversary? That is, when you truly become Buddhists. I remember what I have done for Buddhism? Have I contributed much or little? That the Buddha Sect protects me or that I uphold the Buddha Sect? If the Buddha Church protects us, what should we do to repay Buddha's kindness? If we uphold the Buddha Teaching, then we have to ask how hard we have tried? Are there still residues in the mind? Is my mind and thoughts still cloudy? What have I done to protect Buddhism? After examining these issues clearly, let's see if we are truly a true follower of Buddhism or not? Whether I truly support Buddhism or not?

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the basic place to establish Buddhism in the West, the place of origin of world Buddhism, and also the place of return of world Buddhism. Not only that, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is also the place of return for all other religions. Regardless of religion, you are welcome to come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to study Buddhism!

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas belongs to everyone, to all the Bodhisattvas, to all the Sages, Arhats, Bich Chi Buddhas. The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas belongs to all good men and women. If you are a member of the Buddhist Church, you must definitely support it and not let anyone destroy the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas!

In the past, Venerable Dharma Vi Da and Venerable Gia Lam just stood outside and observed the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, wondering how I, a person with no talent, could build an ashram. They do not know whether the ashram can be established or not.

Now I have to tell Venerable Dharma Protector Vi Da and Venerable Bodhisattva Gia Lam that they cannot stand by and watch anymore; You must do your best to protect the Dharma and do your best to fulfill your responsibility to support the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas!

If there is a City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, there is a Buddha Teaching; If the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is destroyed, the Buddha Teaching will no longer exist! Asian Buddhist Buddhism has already given birth to cancer, it is difficult to cure. In America, Buddhism is starting to grow, so everything needs to use the Dharma!

Dharma Protectors Vi Da and Gia Lam! In the ashram of the Dharma, if you do not wholeheartedly support it, then you are not worthy to be called Vi Da Dharma Protector, nor are you qualified to be Venerable Gia Lam, because the things you have done and the vows you have made in the past are completely contradictory!

Therefore, now I tell you clearly that the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has been established; You must quickly assume the responsibility of protecting the Dharma. All heavenly demons, pagans, goblins, and ghosts, you must not let them come and disturb the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas! Demons are fine, but they cannot cause trouble or disrupt the rules of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Among the ten Dharma Realms, the Buddha here presides over the ashram; The other nine Dharma Realms, including all types of pagan demons, must support the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas.

From now on, no one is allowed in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas without following the rules. Everyone here must carefully guard their precepts. Demons and pagans who come here are at least not allowed to kill, not steal, not commit adultery, not lie, nor drink alcohol or smoke. Regardless of whether you are leaving the home life, a layman, a human, a demon, a fairy, or an animal, you must strictly follow the rules of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, no indulgences allowed!

noi_dung:
THE DEMON MUST ALSO KEEP RULES

(The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas on the evening of July 4, 1982)

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the shining city of the world. Because of the light, the demon king was extremely afraid. At the beginning of the construction of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, the demon kings and their relatives in the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds were all afraid and trembling. They want to use all methods to cause conflict to destroy the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Are the people in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas opposed to them? No! We should always be vigilant and practice!

To practice, you need to use the power of "like immobility" concentration. to overcome, and use the wisdom of "the willow is always clear" to educate and transform the demons in the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds. Of course, demons do not necessarily listen to teachings, but we use skillful means to inspire them, make them happy, take refuge in the Three Jewels, and develop the mind of great Bodhisattva. That is the responsibility of each person in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas.

In the past, Vi Da and Bodhisattva Gia Lam often stood outside and looked at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to see if the pagoda could rise. Song Van Buddha City has now been established, the rules are clearly set; Therefore, Dharma Protector Vida and Bodhisattva Gia Lam, you cannot be indifferent anymore! We cannot ignore our responsibilities and let the devil kings take advantage of the destruction. Bodhisattva Vi Da Dharma Protector once made vows to protect the Buddhist ashram; Bodhisattva Gia Lam also has extensive making vows to protect all ashrams. Therefore, now you should not be indifferent, but need to diligently guard the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, do not give the devil a chance.

Today is America's Independence Day and also the anniversary of the founding of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas; Everyone must keep their precepts and support the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Those who protect the Dharma, such as gods, must not "sit in indifference," but we need to especially develop the mind of great Bodhisattva to support this Hoa Nghiem Ashram; Because the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the realm of Avatamsaka, praising the Great

The Avatamsaka Dharma teaches and transforms all demons in the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds. In the past, demons often came to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to disturb and often destroy the rules of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, but starting from today we must establish those rules and make the Dharma shine more and more brightly!

tieu_de: 35. THE THIEN HA IS BAD IN NO EVENT, THE FULFILLMENT OF THE SELF-NUTTY CHI

noi_dung:
35. THE THIEN HA IS BAD IN NO EVENT, THE FULFILLMENT OF THE SELF-NUTTY CHI

(There is nothing wrong in this world, only stupid people make it up)

I think I can do good things, but actually it's not necessarily good. Why? Because our seeds are not pure. When we put greed into work, the seed is impure. When we put greed into work, the seed is also impure.

So what to do? Must "go unscathed," That means doing something for nothing. Whatever you do, you must consider it as your duty. Don't look outward to pursue it, don't do it because of your need. Every day, whatever we do must be considered as "doing nothing"; so say:

"Originally, there is no one thing, Who is the one in the land of heaven?" (There has never been anything, where is the dust?)Or say:

"See the awakening of the world,

Seeing delusion and falling into hell.

Meaning:

"Seeing things, awakening: beyond the world,

Seeing things, being infatuated: fall into Samsara."

People in this world are full of crazy delusions, which are not easy to get rid of. If you can eliminate it, "you will be far away from your dreams." Then, attain "Nirvana" already!

"No" nor is it emptiness, "form" nor is it form, then it is "the origin of wind and light," is my home in my old hometown. But because we all turn our backs on enlightenment and follow the dusty world, we don't know our inherent land, so we go crazy, running east and west, seeking fame and profit. As long as I have gained fame and benefits then oh well! Unfortunately, I'm almost at a loss!

Therefore, if it is not "the world is inherently unharmed, there is nothing wrong with tolerant people" then what else? There is nothing wrong in the world, it's just stupid people who make it up.

tieu_de: 36. FOR EDUCATION, DO EDUCATION
tom_tat: At the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, the things we do here with people in real life are completely different. For example, there are currently primary schools, secondary schools, and universities, but they are all exempt
noi_dung:
36. FOR EDUCATION, DO EDUCATION

(Van Buddha Thanh August 27, 1982)

At the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, the things we do here with people in real life are completely different. For example, there are currently primary schools, secondary schools, and universities, but they are all free.

Why is that? Because today there are many schools that do not focus on education, only know how to collect tuition, turning schools into places to sell knowledge. When students come to study, we must teach them so that they are not blinded by thoughts of greed and do not focus on money. Ancient people went to school to understand morality; Nowadays, people go to school just because they want fame and fortune, how to become famous and gain a lot of benefits. That's why? It's because the educational methods at school are wrong, and as a result, the world is increasingly deteriorating and depraved.

In the current world, there are two types of monsters appearing to devour humans. Even though we were swallowed up, we didn't know it. Some people think: "Oh! I already know those two monsters, that is, atomic warheads with hydrogen warheads or lasers and X-rays, right?" That's not it! Those things are not as sublime as the kind of monsters I talked about! The two types of monsters I'm talking about here are computers and televisions.

Computer, in Chinese, is called electroencephalogram, because it means "brain". Therefore, it robs people of their wisdom. Television, in Chinese, is called dien thi, the word "thi" meaning to see, therefore it robs you of your ability to see. Someone asked: "I watch TV every day, why haven't my eyes gone blind?" Being blind means you can no longer perceive the truth! I was confused, and I piled on more delusions, I was blind and was led by the blind. That's why nowadays people who kill people, rob, destroy, and do all kinds of bad things learn from TV. But people don't know that, and think that TV, etc. is the ultimate product of the progressive era. In fact, you don't know its deadly effects.

Currently, there is also a third type of monster appearing. What is it? That is a robot. Will robots take over people's jobs, leaving people in the future wondering what else they can do? If humans are useless, they will become waste.

Therefore, in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, if you know a little, you can do a little, not trade words. We need to truly educate children, teaching them to understand how to be filial to their parents and loyal to the country; Know how to humble yourself to receive people, have thoughts of kindness, righteousness, and morality. Is this idea really naive? But do you think there is a better method to change the disasters in this world?

If we want to change the world's calamities, only loyalty, filial piety, benevolence, righteousness, and morality can save the hearts of sunken people and subdue demons. So here, primary schools, secondary schools and universities are all free. Therefore, at this point alone, you must especially understand that this is not just something done for show or for profit like other places.

There is another reason: When I was young, I didn't study much. Regarding the general education of my time, I was not very good. So I just want to create good opportunities and conditions for young people so they can cultivate morality, kindness, and righteousness; making them become useful people for the country and pillars of society in the future.

tom_tat: Each person has their own cause and effect. Whenever you create any karma, you will suffer that retribution. Not only humans are subject to retribution, but so are all sentient beings; Creating karma in the past, reaping the fruit today. That…
noi_dung:
THE GREATEST EVIL PEOPLE ARE MURDERERS AND FLESH-EATERS

(Van Buddha Thanh August 29, 1982)

Each person has their own cause and effect. Whenever you create any karma, you will suffer that retribution. Not only humans are subject to retribution, but so are all sentient beings; Creating karma in the past, reaping the fruit today. That's not easy to understand. For example, if you are reborn as an animal or in an evil place, it is very difficult to restore your human body; should say:

Seventh personal identity,

Thousands of lives are difficult to conquer.

Meaning:

Your body is gone,

It's hard to find.

In the world, there are two types of people: One is good, the other is evil. When we plant good causes, we reap good results; when we plant evil causes, we reap evil results.

The benevolent grower always knows how to "be meticulous and respectful" wherever he goes. (self-assembled according to etiquette), "selfless and respectful to others" (treat others humbly); Always do not take advantage of others' conveniences, always be ready to suffer losses. Whenever anyone encounters any difficulty, I immediately help. Always have the will to do good, make merit and practice virtue, not like someone who only knows their own benefits without thinking about the benefits of others. When my good merit is complete, I will naturally advance, so I say: "Good people, good results." From the human world we can ascend to the heavens, then from the heavens we can ascend to the Arhat realm, the Bich Chi Buddha realm, the Bodhisattva realm, step by step to advance. That is a very prosperous atmosphere. Whenever you create any merit, you will definitely get your reward, merit will never be lost.

What is it that if you plant evil causes, you will reap bad results in the future? That is, if we create injustice and commit all kinds of mistakes, in the future we will receive retribution from hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. Who told me to do such evil? No one told me, I created it myself. There is a saying: Self-harm, Inactive. (If you create evil things yourself, no one can forgive you.) If you cultivate evil deeds, you will fall into the three evil paths. In short, if you do good things you will be promoted, but if you do bad things you will fall down. Therefore, every world is created by you, you must be your own master, do not rely on others.

However, what is the greatest evil? That means killing! If people violate the Five Precepts (killing, religion, lust, delusion, alcohol), they will easily fall into the three evil realms and will also easily become a person full of wrong views, false views, not believing in the Buddha's Dharma, and not respecting the Three Jewels. After falling into the three evil paths, there is no way to describe the suffering.

What is the biggest sin I have committed? That means killing and eating meat. If you eat people's meat, people will eat your meat back. They mutually eat each other, they kill each other, and then they fall to hell. Once you have fallen, it is difficult to move forward, it is extremely dangerous, it is entering "danger". so. There is a saying:

"The Three Realms are insecure,

Because it's like a fire."

Meaning:

"The three realms are not peaceful,

Like a house on fire."

Unfortunately, even though the house was on fire, the people inside still calmly looked down on it!

Today we are celebrating the Vu Lan Dharma Assembly, think about it: We and the Venerable Maudgalyayana, who has higher moral practice? Even though His merit is so high, he still has to ask Buddha to deliverance to His mother; Buddha then set up the Vu Lan Dharma Assembly to save parents and ancestors for seven generations. If I compare myself with Maudgalyayana, I cannot compare. But my parents and ancestors are really waiting for me to beg for deliverance for them. Therefore, let's not waste time, and let's not forget our duties as humans. Once you lose this body, it will be too late to regret!

tieu_de: 38. Don Chapter LAP DUC
tom_tat: People who study Buddhism need to make Buddhism develop more and more brightly, not let Buddhism decline day by day. How to grow brighter day by day? First, we must foster excellent character, taking that as...
noi_dung:
38. LAPTUC PRODUCTS

(Van Buddha Thanh October 10, 1982)

People who study Buddhism need to make Buddhism develop more and more brightly, not let Buddhism decline day by day. How to grow brighter day by day? First, we must foster excellent character and use that as a good foundation. When there is a strong foundation, the castle cannot collapse. It is impossible to build a building from an unstable foundation. In terms of practice, it is necessary to have a solid foundation, first of all it is necessary to "establish virtue."

What is considered "unfinished product"? That is, making virtues better. What is kindness? That means don't have a harsh personality, don't be petty, don't be cunning and crooked. In other words, the mind must be as vast as space, covering the entire Dharma Realm, there is nothing that cannot be covered or tolerated!

Think about it, nothingness has to accept only good things, it is ready to accept even polluted and dirty air. So do we: We must have a broad mind, to accommodate everything in countless worlds, including the Three Teachings, the Nine Streams, all forms, all things, good and bad, good and evil. That is to improve one's moral character, to cultivate one's own virtue.

We need to humbly entertain others, always admit that we have made mistakes, and accept encouragement and guidance from others. Always look for ways to improve for the better, don't cling to ego, don't have an ego, don't consider "I" This is huge, important. That is "the foundation of establishing virtue," Make your foundation strong. If we can do that, then Buddhism will definitely develop and shine!

tieu_de: 39. DAO
tom_tat: Fish are in the water without knowing they are in the water. Humans live in the air but cannot see air. Even though you can't see it, you can't say there's no air. Even though air has no form,...
noi_dung:
39. DAO

(Van Buddha Thanh October 10, 1982)

Fish are in the water without knowing they are in the water. Humans live in the air but cannot see air. Even though you can't see it, you can't say there's no air. Although air has no form, it is not without air.

Fish are born in water, they look but cannot see water; But once the fish is out of the water, it cannot live. Humans rely on air to survive; Although eating air does not make you full, you need air to survive. All things will die from lack of air.

The human world has air; In heaven there is also a type of Spirit, Divine nature; In Buddha, there is Buddha nature. Although Buddha nature and God nature cannot be seen, the realm of the Saint cannot be absent. Without the Spirit, the gods will fall. If there is no Buddha nature, there is no Buddha. That is truly an extremely magical realm.

"Practice" that is, cultivating the invisible Great Dao, cultivating the emotionless Great Dao, cultivating the nameless Great Dao. Therefore, Thai Thuong Lao Quan said in the Thanh Tinh Sutra:

"The Great Path is invisible, creating heaven and earth.

The Great Dao is merciless, operating on the sun and moon.

The nameless Great Path nourishes all things.

Wu does not know the name, but forces the name for the Way."

Meaning:

"The Great Way has no form, but gives birth to heaven and earth.

The Great Way has no emotions, but revolves around the sun and moon

The Great Way has no name, but nourishes all things.

I don't know what the name is, so I call it Dao."

The word "Dao" Hey, according to Chinese characters, there are two dots on the head, that is, a negative point and a positive point; Also from the word "human", meaning human, it turns out that these two points are the word "human". written upside down. Cultivating the Way means turning upside down, going against the current, not going with the flow. Going with the flow means birth and death, but going against the flow means Nirvana! The word "paradise", meaning upside down, also has two dots above, which is also due to the word "human". that came out. So if you want to go right then go right, if you want to go wrong then go wrong. Below the two dots in the word "Dao" There is a horizontal line, which means the word "first". The word "human" This is divided into one yin and one yang; "Heavenly Yin, Heavenly Yang" then called "Pole" ("heaven" meaning biased, when negative is biased or when positive is biased, it will reach the extreme).

And where is the Tao of man? From the word "first" This is the number one (1) to find. One (1) is the essence of numbers. Where does this one come from? This one comes from zero (0). It's "no" then there is neither inside nor outside, neither beginning nor end, sweeping away all dharmas, abandoning all appearances; When released it covers everything, rolled up it hides and cannot be seen. All things start from "zero" This comes out. Mountains and rivers, land, houses, forests, everything comes from "zero". This is where it starts.

To put it more clearly, "zero" This is the original Buddha nature, the brilliant and bright Great Light Store, if shrunk it would be smaller than a grain of dust, if it grew bigger it would cover the Dharma Realm. Therefore, it is infinitely large and infinitely small; There is no limit at all which is "zero". so. However, people do not know how to keep the rules and bring "zero" If this is broken, it becomes "number one." Therefore if there is only "zero" but there is no "number one," There are no other numbers, and there is no need for other numbers!

Therefore, the original is a bright and radiant aura, then it turns into One. This one: One side is yin, the other side is yang, which means that from one yin and one yang, all things are born. People cultivating the Way must start from this number one place.

In the word "Dao", below the word "one" There is the word "self", now I have to look for the word "self." The word "self", meaning oneself, consists of a comma and the word "dump". means eye; That is, you must use your eyes to reflect light, but to look inward, not outside to look. Closing your eyes is the word "self", that is, yourself.

Now, if we add the word "suc" On the other side, it becomes the word "Dao", meaning that Dao needs to be practiced, because the word "sho" means go, step, practice.

Mr. Han Du in Tap Nguyen Dao said:

"Due to the teachings of peace and quiet, the Way is established."

(Going from this place to that place is called the Tao.)

"Religion" It means the path, so cultivating the Way requires practical practice, truly practicing, with effort and utmost sincerity. If you want to return to the original position, you need to start from the "number one" place. This practice returns to "zero."

"The best of all things" (If you get One, everything is done). If I can restore "zero" This means that we can return to our original appearance and can turn the wonderful Dharma wheel.

tieu_de: 40. TRUE, THANH, HANG
tom_tat: A practitioner is not allowed to sell, advertise or propagate his or her spiritual career. When you sell or advertise your practice, you can be destroyed by the devil
noi_dung:
40. TRUE, THANH, HANG

(Van Buddha Thanh October 22, 1982)

A practitioner is not allowed to sell, advertise or propagate his or her spiritual career. When you sell or advertise your practice, you may be disrupted by demons!

Some people practice and Buddha comes to protect them; Some people are protected by Bodhisattva, some are protected by Arhats; Some people are supported by Heaven; Some people are protected by demons; For some people, someone comes to protect them; But for some people, demons and demons come to protect them. Because those people have evil hearts, the devil becomes friends with them. Whenever we have misunderstandings or wrong views, we will create many kinds of demons; That is, high tribute, arrogance, and arrogance. If we don't know how to be humble, patient, and don't know how to admit our mistakes, we can encounter many obstacles.

So today I want to tell you a true method of practice. The secret of practice consists of three words:

Legs: meaning not false, not false; Whatever you do, do it honestly.

Thanh: It means to be sincere, very respectful, very sincere, not lazy to entertain, not going through the motions.

Hang: It means always steadfast, constant, unchanging.

Every action, every word must have a sincere, sincere, and constant heart. Whatever you do, if you have those three minds, your future will definitely be successful.

tieu_de: 41. WORDS OF ENCOURAGEMENT FOR THE BEGINNING OF THE YEAR
tom_tat: Time passed really quickly. Now the old year has ended and the new year has come without me even knowing it. Human life is the same, from birth to old age and death, we don't know. Birth, old age, illness, and death whirl around so quickly...
noi_dung:
41. WORDS OF ENCOURAGEMENT FOR THE BEGINNING OF THE YEAR

(Van Buddha Thanh February 10, 1983)

Time passed really quickly. Now the old year has ended and the new year has come without me even knowing it. Human life is the same, from birth to old age and death, we don't know. Birth, old age, illness, and death whirl around quickly, but people are confused and let year after year pass by. If we don't enlighten the issue of life and death, we will be born confused and then die confused. What is the meaning of living like that? Look! Every country, every family, every individual is heading towards that path of old age and death; Born in a lake, then die in a lake!

The confusion of life and death is due to being obscured by ignorance. Why is there ignorance? Because "one thought without enlightenment gives birth to three sacrifices" (Due to a stupid thought, three subtle states of consciousness are born: Karma, Appearance and Transformation). Once the three appearances have arisen, the changes are endless; Therefore, in our life there are thousands of states, all kinds of causes and conditions. If we can enlighten this state, we must quickly develop the Bodhi mind and pray for wisdom to understand everything.

Buddha is extremely wise and extremely knowledgeable, so he is called the Great Enlightened One. We need to return from a place of confusion and ignorance to a place of clarity and clarity. First, we must make every effort to wipe out all bad habits, bad habits, and mistakes; and at that time, bright wisdom will appear.

This year, Tet is coming, wishing you great enlightenment! A day has passed, the network is gradually decreasing, like a fish out of water, what's the fun? The masses! Be diligent, like your head is burned, Always remember impermanence, Don't be careless!

SHOULD CHILDREN BE LEFT TO DEVELOP FREELY?

IS IT?

(Van Buddha Thanh March 20, 1983)

"Heaven and Earth are great,

Four seas chi drill,

Absolutely nothing."

Meaning:

"Heaven and earth are vast,

Four vast seas,

Strange things abound."

The world has countless special and strange things that we cannot imagine. But everything is partly created by God, partly created by people. Even though God created people without doing anything, they will not succeed; People who do things but God doesn't create them have no basis. Therefore, everything in life is relative, there is good and evil, there is yin and yang, there is right and wrong, there is good and bad; That is the method of treating people.

Because it is a method of treatment, if people know how to do it, bad things can turn into good things. If people don't know how to do things, then good things can also become bad! In the same way, a person who knows how to apply energy can transform it into positive energy when the yin energy is extremely strong, and when the positive energy is extremely strong, it can also be harmonized. Sound belongs to stillness and softness; As for yang, it belongs to movement and erection; Therefore, good and bad things are made by humans. The ancients said:

"The cultivator's chain,

Wearing black and white clothes,

Tam U Lam Tam Lam,

Nhan U Hoang Tac Hoang."

Meaning:

"Red near lipstick,

Near ink is black,

Dyed green is green,

Dyed yellow is yellow."

China has a demi-Saint named Mencius. When he was young, his father passed away early, leaving only his mother to raise him. At first, His house was next to the butcher's house. Because he was young, his ears and eyes were easily infected with anything, so he learned every day how a butcher pokes the blood of buffaloes and goats. His mother saw this and knew that if he was allowed to develop freely, he would definitely become a butcher in the future. So she immediately moved out of the house, and moved next to the cemetery.

At that time, Mencius learned the ways of a tombkeeper: sweep the ground, burn incense, offer flowers, and make offerings to the dead. His mother then thought: "It's not done! If children are allowed to develop freely, they will become gravekeepers in the future, what benefit will they gain? So the second time she moved house again. This time, she moved house next to the school.

Next to the school, Mencius devoted himself every day to imitating the students there: Go to class to greet teachers, go home to greet your parents. Although his family had no money, Mencius tried his best to study; He is very proficient in reading, walking, standing, ceremony, and meaning. His mother saw that and decided to stay there because as long as her child imitates the reader, he will be successful in the future.

But not long after, Mencius became destructive and disobedient and no longer wanted to study. One day, his mother was weaving silk. When she saw her child skipping school and coming home, she immediately cut the loom, causing the silk thread to break into two pieces. Mencius saw this and immediately thought: "The loom is broken and we can no longer weave, so our family's livelihood will be difficult, because all daily activities rely on this weaving profession." That's why He asked his mother: "Why did Mom cut the loom like that?"

She replied: "If you don't study now, it's like a loom that can no longer weave!" After hearing this, Mencius was extremely ashamed and determined to study hard. Later, he became a great saint of Confucianism.

In this country of America, I cannot say that freedom to develop is completely wrong. However, if freedom develops too much, it is a mistake. If this concept exists, it will foster disaster. Children are like young trees growing; If the tree sprouts and branches haphazardly, it needs to be pruned so that in the future it will grow straight, just like children must be well educated to be able to become pillars of the nation in the future!

If your child has a left-handed writing problem, it is not very convenient. The right hand belongs to the gentle nature, the left hand belongs to the strong nature; The right hand is yin, the left hand is yang. If there is a child in the family who writes left-handed, it is best to change it, so that writing with the right hand is more convenient. Just like circumambulating Buddha, you walk from the right, everything starts from the right hand, that is in accordance with your nature, that is flexible. Children who are left-handed have a more or less strong character.

I recommend to parents that if their children make any mistakes, they should immediately correct their mistakes. To develop freely, they will turn into "hippies" in the future. rogue, thug. What should we do then? There is a sentence:

"It's too much to raise an uneducated father,

The fall of an unstrict teacher."

Meaning:

" Raising without teaching is the father's fault,

Teaching without rigor is the teacher's shortcoming."

Should we not be careful to prevent it? If we want to talk about true freedom and development, we must put children in high mountains and wild forests, without any restrictions, allowing them to freely survive like natural herbs grow. Otherwise, "free development" cannot be mentioned. okay. If you think that following a child's wishes is the freedom to develop, then that is a misconception. If children do the right thing, encourage and encourage them to continue doing it; If they do wrong, we must correct them so they can move towards the right and good things. For humanity to continue to survive in this society, we must maintain wise actions; The term "free development" cannot be mistakenly used. This is okay.

When children are left free and unruly, in the future they will turn into spoiled, extremely tyrannical, and strong-willed teenagers. They cannot become handsome people but will be corrupt members of society. If the country lacks high salaries and talented people, the consequences are unpredictable!

tieu_de: 43. THE DANGER OF SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNICAL PROGRESS
tom_tat: Everyone in the human race "pursues outward." Because the demand is outside the mind, the more you seek, the farther away from the root you will be, unable to reach the destination; The more you can't reach your destination, the more you want to pursue more. That's called "leaving the roots along with the tops, leaving close to...
noi_dung:
43. THE DANGER OF SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNICAL PROGRESS

(Van Buddha Thanh March 25, 1983)

Everyone in the human race "pursues outward." Because the demand is outside the mind, the more you seek, the farther away from the root you will be, unable to reach the destination; The more you can't reach your destination, the more you want to pursue more. That's called "leaving the roots and following the tops, leaving the near and following the far."

You give us computers, TVs, phones, refrigerators, etc. are good and beautiful, in fact they represent external things that make people confused, attached to things, and not enlightened. But if we really understand everything, those things can help us enlightenment. The six senses (ears, eyes, nose, tongue, body, mind) are the six robbers that make people fall, but if you know how to use them, you can practice to attain Supreme Bodhi, Buddha!

Although there is an electric brain appearing on the outside, inside our own nature is also full of such wonderful and unimaginable things. In the past, I didn't need to look outward in pursuit. However, because of the magical treasure that is difficult to describe, it is called "permanently residing in the true mind, pure and clear nature" Ours is obscured by the Five Skandhas, so that treasure cannot appear. Then, due to ignorance, we leave the roots and follow the tops, leave the near and chase the far, without knowing how to turn around and look back at our own mind.

There is electricity on the outside because there is electricity in the brain within one's own nature. That electrical brain is called Divine brain, it can also be called Holy brain, Buddha brain, or Great Wisdom. Nowadays, although scientists have invented all kinds of new things, they are all things outside the mind, the more they seek them, the farther they get from the origin. Scientists only understand superficial things; Although it seems like they have achieved something, in reality, they have lost their original wisdom, so it is called "abandoning the roots and following the roots."

Those who practice the Way must "leave the tops and follow the roots," What must we do to perfect our original Buddha nature, how must we restore our original nature, to restore our original wisdom, that is, the Great Complete Landscape Wisdom, the Equality Wisdom, the Wonderful Contemplation Wisdom, and the Achieving Wisdom. If we compare the brain's electricity with these four Wisdoms, the brain's electricity is only one part of the hundreds of thousands of millions of parts of the other four Wisdoms. Many people take brass and think it's real gold. What a pity!

Therefore, as cultivators of the Tao, we must recognize our own inherent wisdom, and do not need to pursue distant, sublime things outside.

Do we absolutely not need those external things? I have said that the brain is a demon created by science, making people lose karma, become lazy, like to indulge, and hate hard work. If this bad situation continues, humanity will soon turn into waste, no longer usable. When humans are useless, of course the theater in this world will quickly end; Because humans are useless, what else do we need humans to do? But on the contrary, if people are enlightened, they will use their wisdom to use technology, not letting technology control people. At that time, of course people will create many products that are beneficial to humanity!

In short, it is a product but the important thing is whether we know how to use it or not. I have to use my brain's electricity, not let it control me! So say:

"Events, events: out of the world,

Knowledge, passion: damnation."

Translated as:

"Seeing what happened, immediately woke up: beyond the world,

Having a conversation, but being vague: fall into Samsara."

tieu_de: IMPROVE THE STANDARDS OF MONASTIC PRODUCTS, ACTIVELY PROMOTE KINH LANG NGHIEM
tom_tat: We are in the end of the Dharma, we have been away from Buddha for too long, but the Dharma has not been completely destroyed. You still have the opportunity to practice according to the Buddha's teachings, and you still have the opportunity to witness the results
noi_dung:
IMPROVE THE STANDARDS OF MONASTIC PRODUCTS, ACTIVELY PROMOTE KINH LANG NGHIEM

(Van Buddha Thanh April 14, 1983)

We are in the end of the Dharma, we have been away from Buddha for too long, but the Dharma has not been completely destroyed. You still have the opportunity to practice according to Buddha's teachings, you still have the opportunity to attain Buddhahood!

If you are the one leaving the home life, you must be determined to maintain the principle that no matter how difficult the hardships are, you will never change your stance. No matter who comes to sabotage, don't let yourself be shaken. You just need to be clearly aware of what you are doing, the path you are on is bright and righteous, and then move forward courageously.

During the Dharma Ending Age, heavenly demons, pagans, demigods, delusions, mountain demons, sea monsters, the most feared was the Shurangama Mantra because the Shurangama Mantra had the ability to destroy evil and bring about righteousness, and because of the Shurangama Mantra, Buddha preached the Shurangama Sutra, a core sutra of Buddha's teachings!

If humans do not have bones and marrow, they will die. If Buddhism does not have the Shurangama Sutra, Buddha Dharma will be destroyed. Therefore, the best method to uphold the Dharma in the Dharma Ending Age is to memorize the Shurangama Sutra and memorize the Shurangama Mantra fluently. After reading and memorizing to the point of being extremely proficient, try your best to promote the principles of the Sutra and lecture it to everyone. If this world lacks the Shurangama Mantra, demons and ghosts will have nothing to fear anymore, they will be free to rampage. But because in the world there are still people reciting Shurangama mantras, the Bang Mon, the Left Path, the Lazy Luong, the Ly My, the Mountain Demons, and the Water Monsters are still afraid and do not dare to appear openly. Without the Shurangama Mantra, this world would become a world of demons and ghosts!

You see, today's human thinking is very strange, some people are not as good as animals. That's because demons and ghosts roam the world, bewitching people, causing them to lose their basic wisdom, turning into deceitful people who no longer know how to be merciful, and do vile things that are no longer equal to animals. That's also because fewer and fewer people know how to chant Shurangama sutras and reciting Shurangama mantras, so pagan demons are rampaging and no longer respect anything!

However, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the place of origin of Buddha Dharma in the West, the gathering place of the essence of true Buddhist practitioners in the world, so the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is not the operating area of demons and demons, they cannot set foot in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas! There are people who cannot stay at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas because they are not virtuous enough, their thoughts are full of wrong knowledge and wrong views, so they only stay for a while before their true form is revealed and they have to go elsewhere.

From now on, in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, those leaving the home life and lay disciples need to memorize the Shurangama Sutra. Thus, for Buddha Dharma there is no greater merit. Because there are famous professors, famous scholars, even people leaving the home life, now openly saying that the Shurangama Sutra is fake!

Why are they so crazy? This is because the Shurangama Sutra mentions the Four Commandments of Purity, and at the same time the Fifty Skandhas. Therefore, they cannot bear to stand in front of these love mirrors mentioned in the Shurangama Sutra. When they compare themselves with fifty types of skandhas, their demonic nature appears clearly, and when they compare themselves with the four teachings on purity, they cannot keep the rules mentioned in this Sutra. Because they cannot bear that truth, they cover up their conscience, and denigrate that the Shurangama Sutra is fake!

Therefore, regarding the Shurangama Sutra and the Shurangama Mantra, we need to clearly realize that there is no mantra as effective as the Shurangama Mantra, no sutra more authentic than the Shurangama Sutra. This is because this sutra presents all the wrong things of pagan demons, and all sentient beings, extremely clearly and thoroughly.

Without the Shurangama Mantra, the Buddha Dharma would no longer exist, without the Shurangama Sutra, the Dharma would be destroyed! Therefore, for the sake of protecting the Buddha Dharma, you must memorize the Shurangama Sutra! If you can always preach, then you will not be ashamed of being a true disciple of Buddha, not ashamed of leaving the home life in vain.

That's why you don't let "renowned scholars" "famous professors," or "Great Masters" delude, like a blind person following a blind person and believing that the Shurangama Sutra is fake! On what basis do they dare to say that the Shurangama Sutra is fake? With blind words, high tributes, full of wrong views, arrogance, and delusion, they will suffer unimaginable consequences in the future.

Regardless of the family style of other ashrams, at Van Buddha Thanh, anyone who wants to leave the home life must have at least a Bachelor's degree! If you pass your Bachelor's degree at another school, you need to join the Sangha training program at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas; They must undergo three years of serious training to achieve academic and moral excellence before being eligible to receive full ordination as a Bhikkhu or Bhikkhuni.

In this era, people leaving the home life definitely need to be outstanding, especially transcendent, and have an excellent educational background, in order to become a Dharma Master. If you are not fluent in words, all day you only know how to hook up, use tricks, beg, and take advantage; Or someone who pretends to be a monk to make ends meet, or just does things that are completely not noble, not pure, and specializes in breaking the precepts, then that person only disgraces the Buddha's door. How can the Buddha's teaching become brighter and brighter? How can we make people revere the Three Jewels?

So from now on, those who want to leave the home life in the City of Thousand Buddhas, regardless of whether they are male or female, old or young, first need to pass a Bachelor's degree, then need to memorize the Shurangama Mantra and Shurangama Sutra to be eligible to leave the home life. In addition, people leaving the home life need to memorize the novice precepts, the 53 minor mantras, the Brahma Vong Bodhisattva Sutra and master the Four Parts of Discipline (i.e. the Bhikkhu Precepts and Bhikshuni Precepts). Previously, in this ashram, the leaving the home life standard was not as strict as it is now, but I did not accept disciples carelessly. Before accepting anyone, I am very careful, allowing them to spend a long time observing their thoughts and behavior before accepting them, then distributing them to leaving the home life. But in this Dharma Ending Age, evil spirits are rampant, so I cannot help but make radical changes and actively promote the moral character and education of monastics. Everyone who follows me leaving the home life needs to have their "head on the sky, feet on the ground," Completely talented in literature and martial arts, he is a dragon statue in Buddha's door. Even if you look at it with mundane eyes, it must be a person of extraordinary, extraordinary talent. Those who have followed me leaving the home life for a long time also need to memorize the Shurangama Sutra and be ready to explain it if needed. Only then can we truly take on the responsibility of propagating the Dharma, continuing the Buddha's mission, and not wasting our career leaving the home life!

tieu_de: 45. NEWLY ESTABLISHED ASHOLOGY
tom_tat: The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas had just been established, everything was not stable, so there were chaotic and disorderly things. Outsiders who come here to stay do not understand the rules at all, so many things are not done properly. Trong…
noi_dung:
45. NEWLY ESTABLISHED ASHOLOGY

(Van Buddha Thanh April 15, 1983)

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas had just been established, everything was not stable, so there were chaotic and disorderly things. Outsiders who come here to stay do not understand the rules at all, so many things are not done properly. During this period, those who come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas have good and bad, snakes and dragons mixed together. In fact, bad people are examples for good people, good people are also examples for bad people, so the two sides set an example for each other, each other preach the Dharma, and each other reflect each other. Humans are like that, Buddha, Bodhisattva, Dharma Protector are like that, and so are pagan demons.

Here the ashram has just been established, there are many Dharma Protectors. Because perhaps they have never done the work of protecting the dharma in the past, or because they are lazy and want to relax, when a problem arises, they do not know how to resolve it smoothly. Just like someone new to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, they don't know how to handle any problem. Therefore, there are many heavenly demons and monsters who want to take the opportunity to come here and take advantage of the "turbid water to fish". to profit.

However, incompleteness is the beginning of completeness. Those who live in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas absolutely need to be virtuous; Without virtue, it would be impossible for them to be here because they would not feel free or at ease. A virtuous person finds his body and mind very peaceful, very happy, and free. Because of that feeling, we can know what kind of ashram the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is. Buddha Bodhisattva, the Dharma Protector, is extremely happy with virtuous people; But the demons don't like it. They want to make these virtuous people go away; Therefore, they use all sorts of magical powers and magic tricks to make them lose their minds. Even stupid animals and insects come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to demonstrate their bravery and act as monsters.

In life, there is good and there is bad, so we must know:

"Trach Thien Nhi Tung,

Unkind children reform.

Thi Dao Tac Tien Tien,

Non-Dao is rotten."

Translated as:

"If you make a good choice, follow it.

If it's not good, fix it.

If it is the Way then move forward,

If it is not the Way, then you will retreat."

It is necessary to have right knowledge and right view, which means it is necessary to have correct understanding and correct concepts. What is correct understanding and concept? That means not fighting, not being greedy, not pursuing, not being selfish, not doing things for personal gain, and not lying!

If you come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas and still have a big ego and think you are good, then you are mistaken! In the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, if you are a dragon, you must curl up, if you are a tiger, you must lie down; Everyone must strictly follow the rules, no exceptions. If you are aware of your virtue and good roots, don't waste it, don't enter the mountain of gold without knowing it and then leave the mountain empty-handed!

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas and other ashrams are no different. The only difference is that the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas does not fight, is not greedy, does not seek, is not selfish, does not seek personal gain, and does not lie!

tieu_de: THE FOUR COMMANDMENTS TEACHING ABOUT TRUE, INCREDIBLE PURE NATURE
tom_tat: The Four Commandments About Pure Nature (Four Purity and Repentance) in the Shurangama Sutra are: "Stop lust, stop killing, stop recording, stop lying" (stop lust, stop killing, stop stealing, stop lying). Those four things are correlated…
noi_dung:
THE FOUR COMMANDMENTS TEACHING ABOUT TRUE, INCREDIBLE PURE NATURE

(Van Buddha Thanh April 17, 1983)

The Four Commandments About Pure Nature (Four Purity and Repentance) in the Shurangama Sutra are: "Cut off adultery, Stop killing, Stop recording, Stop lying" (stop lust, stop killing, stop stealing, stop lying). Those four things are very closely correlated with each other. If you break the precept of sexual immorality, you can easily break the precept of killing and also easily break the precept of stealing, which is stealing, and the precept of lying, which is lying. Because violating the precepts of sexual immorality, killing, morality, and delusion are all included, so even though they are divided into four, when put together they are one!

Buddha is truly extremely compassionate, wholeheartedly and wholeheartedly teaching us the Four Commandments of Purity. Even though he said it so clearly, some people didn't believe it. It's not just some people who don't believe, among them, those who don't believe are scholars, professors, those leaving the home life who don't keep precepts. Those people have no faith, so there is no way to improve, nor is there any way to eliminate the root of their wrong views; Because their misconceptions are so intertwined and ingrained, they lose faith and openly believe that the Shurangama Sutra is fake!

Among the sutras that Buddha spoke, the Shurangama Sutra is a very important sutra. Even if scholars, professors, those who do not keep precepts, or those who use all kinds of magical powers and show eighteen transformations, come and tell me that the Shurangama Sutra is fake, I still cannot believe it! Why? Because the Shurangama Sutra teaches very true principles, it shows the illnesses of sentient beings very clearly; that is "karma of ignorance." This sutra is "giving medicine to the disease," is the clearest advice. But no one wants to drink bitter medicine, even though good medicine is too bitter and difficult to bear. So even if a good doctor gives a prescription, they throw it away and don't use it, saying that the medicine has no effect, that this medicine is just to deceive people. So it is true that you deceive yourself and others, you harm yourself and then harm others!

That's why ignorant people keep running after these people, saying that there are famous scholars like this, there are famous teachers like that, or there are Great Dharma Masters with such a name saying that this Shurangama Sutra is fake; Then they ran after those people like blind people following blind people, together they were both singers and calamities. What people say is what they say, so in the end heresy abounds.

If that's really the case, meaning the Shurangama Sutra is fake, then those in the Buddha's teachings don't need to keep any precepts, nor do they need to listen to these Four Commandments of Purity, and also don't need to know what the Fifty Skandhas are like, everything is thrown away in one go! Think about it, this kind of person is truly extremely evil; If people like that don't go to Hell to have their Tongues Cut Out, then there really is no justice anymore!

Recently I talked about a child with a mental illness (this child has a perverted psychology, strange behavior, and is sick all over his body). The reason this child is sick is because in his previous life he had blasphemed the Mahayana scriptures, creating a karma crime and falling into the Endless Hell. Now he is born as a human being and must suffer such retribution. That's also because we humans don't understand morality, and still consider ourselves good and good, then openly create all kinds of karma crimes, and roll our eyes and lie. Acting like that really means losing all conscience and energy, destroying one's own wisdom; How pitiful!

Because those who slandered the Mahayana scriptures used their ears, eyes, nose, tongue, body, and mind to create all kinds of evil karma, when they were born as humans, they became mentally perverted people, became senseless, unconscious, and when they received evil retribution, they even thought that they were good or very good!

We should not use "fake intelligence" own and blaspheme Buddha's words. These are very famous people, famous scholars, erudite professors, famous Dharma Masters, once they speak words that slander Buddha Dharma, their words will, invisibly, affect hundreds of millions of countless, countless, boundless other people, causing those people to lose their true faith. So you see, isn't creating such karma crimes extremely harmful? Hundreds of thousands of lives later, they will be reincarnated as people who receive retribution, becoming mute people! Because they harm other people's views and say things that make others misunderstand morality, that is extremely harmful!

Think about it, why do those people think that the Shurangama Sutra is fake?
