Others who see such behavior will criticize those leaving the home life in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas for not understanding the rules. With such an attitude, how can we practice the Way, how can we achieve the Way of karma?

Don't let the reputation of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas be tarnished or destroyed because one or two individuals do not keep the rules! The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is a bright light of Buddhism in the world, therefore, every person in the mass, every move, every word, every action, must be especially careful!

People leaving the home life to practice the Way must always control themselves and not have idle thoughts or delusions. Regardless of whether it is good delusion or bad delusion, everything must be swept away, hence the saying "one thought does not arise." Only when we reach this realm can we be in harmony with the Tao. If you have useless delusions, even if your body is pure but your mind is noisy, how can you practice the Way? How can it be achieved? That's really a waste of time, not cultivating the Way!

A person who truly practices practice has absolutely no delusions. If there are false thoughts, there are obstacles. If there are obstacles, you cannot progress, and it is very easy to lose your mind of the Way.

At Van Buddha Thanh, regardless of whether you are leaving the home life or staying away, if you don't need something, don't go to someone else's bedroom. Because you come to my room to talk about this and that, then I come to your room to talk about this and that, it will be a waste of time and useless. It's okay if you don't practice, but you can't hinder others from practicing! If a person hinders his practice, he will fall into the Unending Hell in the future and will never be able to restore his human life!

Once we have developed the mind to cultivate the Way, we need to stay single-minded, especially regretting time, so we say: "One minute of light, one inch of gold, One minute of gold, one minute of time, one inch of gold, How can gold buy a minute of time?"

Again: "If you lose a needle of gold, you will find it difficult to find the light from the past." (An inch of gold lost is easy to find again, Lost in time is hard to find!)

You need to regret the time! Everyone who cultivates the Way must take advantage of time and not waste it. Who knows, in one minute, in one second, you may have the opportunity to become enlightened!

In the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, do not talk while eating.

Before eating, the assembly chants the making offerings with the sentence: "Distracting mind and talking nonsense, Trust is difficult to resolve." This means that if the mind is scattered and talks nonsense, it will make the donor's making offerings difficult to digest. Even though we recite like that, why don't we keep the rules?

People say: "If there are no rules, there will be no compromise." (If there are no rules, there will be no discipline.)

If you don't keep the rules, how can you have wisdom? How to become enlightened? That's why Confucius once said: "It's really speechless, Tam is speechless." (Eating doesn't talk, sleeping doesn't sleep.)

In Trai Duong, when eating, you should not talk loudly, you should only pay attention to eating; This is not only in accordance with regulations but also hygienic. Because eating slowly and chewing thoroughly is easy to digest and beneficial to your health!

tieu_de: WITHOUT CULTIVATING THE PRECEPTS AND CONCENTRATION THEN GIVES WISDOM
tom_tat: Not cultivating the Precepts but wanting to gain Wisdom is absurd. To practice the precepts, words must be accompanied by actions, actions must follow the words, always strictly follow the rules, do not do anything outside the rules. Precepts are the thread…
noi_dung:
WITHOUT CULTIVATING THE PRECEPTS AND CONCENTRATION THEN GIVES WISDOM

(Van Buddha Thanh October 17, 1983)

Not cultivating the Precepts but wanting to gain Wisdom is absurd. To practice the precepts, words must be accompanied by actions, actions must follow the words, always strictly follow the rules, do not do anything outside the rules. Gender is the plumb line, the measuring stick of the person leaving the home life.

Why are there so many rules? Because lay people don't keep rules, so if leaving the home life, there need to be rules and regulations. Without observing the precepts, of course you will not have Concentration. If Precepts and Concentration are not perfect, you will absolutely not develop true Wisdom. If there is, it is also a type of Wisdom called "little intelligence," only makes you go down a crooked, narrow path. That cunning intelligence cannot be called true wisdom; For Great Wisdom, it is just the cunning intelligence of demons!

Without the slightest bit of wrong understanding or wrong view, then there is true wisdom. If you are a truly wise person, you will not be afraid of losing anything, you will understand everything at a glance.

What ordinary people cannot do is "cut off desire and eliminate craving," cut off love and desire. Why can't they do it? Because they do not have true wisdom, they are dominated by ignorance and stupidity. If we have true wisdom, everything will be resolved naturally and well.

tieu_de: PARENTS ARE EXAMPLES FOR THEIR CHILDREN
tom_tat: The world is good or bad because of the family. If the family has good education, the future of their children will be bright; If the family does not educate properly, the future of their children will be dark. Although it is not possible to discuss in detail, but roughly…
noi_dung:
PARENTS ARE EXAMPLES FOR THEIR CHILDREN

The world is good or bad because of the family. If the family has good education, the future of their children will be bright; If the family does not educate properly, the future of their children will be dark. Although it is impossible to discuss in detail, in general, the actual situation does not have much deviation; Therefore, parents must be careful in every action and deed, and cannot arbitrarily do whatever they want.

If parents do not test their own behavior, it is easy to influence their children and cause them to become spoiled. If children are not educated, they will become bad elements of society and the country in the future. Therefore, parents must take responsibility for education by "acting independently," set an example for your children. Every action must be extremely bright and brilliant, must forget oneself for others and must have compassion for others. Children who see such a good example will naturally become excellent citizens, and in the future will help stabilize society and control the country.

Nowadays, ignorant people have done truly amazing things. They lure unsuspecting young men into depravity without those young men even knowing it, even thinking they are doing the right thing. There should be a sentence:

"The first seven days of hatred turn into a thousand years of hatred. Returning back to the beginning of a hundred years ago."Translated as:

"One wrong step, holding on to eternal hatred,

Returning apologetically, a hundred years have passed!"

Such a social atmosphere is truly evil to the extreme. If parents are low-class and low-class, their children will also be low-class and low-class. Anyone who cultivates the Tao and studies Buddha should not associate with bad people, but must keep themselves pure and learn the manners of righteous men and women, in order to change the atmosphere of contemporary society. You absolutely must know how to stay calm, not participate in dishonest organizations, nor approve of improper enjoyment of sensual pleasures. Only then can we influence others to change their ways.

tieu_de: 77. CHINA'S INHERENT CULTURE
tom_tat: In Chinese, when making parallel sentences, the yin, yin, equal, and negative must be correct. But nowadays, if we teach this subject to Westerners, most of them do not understand the sounds. Now that you're starting to learn, I don't have too high requirements; I will teach…
noi_dung:
77. CHINA'S INHERENT CULTURE

(Van Buddha Thanh November 5, 1983)

In Chinese, when making parallel sentences, the yin, yin, equal, and negative must be correct. But nowadays, if we teach this subject to Westerners, most of them do not understand the sounds. Now that you're starting to learn, I don't have too high requirements; I will teach you a step-by-step method to do it. First of all, you have to create a solid foundation, then it's not too late to pay attention to rhymes.

Parallel is a subject that is no longer taught, so many students in China today do not know how to do it, or despise making parallel sentences. In fact, this subject is a manifestation of humanity's wisdom. Dialogue is also a highly unique subject of Chinese culture that Western culture cannot compare to. The reason is because the parallel sentences must be based on the philosophy of yin and yang, heaven and earth, universe, male and female... happens and becomes. The tureen is both refining and rich in meaning, and at the same time has the effect of opening the mind and mind.

China is now starting to pay attention again to making parallel sentences. During the Qing Dynasty, there was Mr. Ky Hieu Lam who was very good at making parallel sentences. noi_dung:
LIVING BEINGS ARE pathetic, they do not know how to save themselves

(Van Buddha Thanh August 29, 1982)

Humans are a part of Buddha, a part of Buddha's spiritual nature, not the whole. For example, Buddha emitted light from a single pore, and within that light, countless living beings transformed; Or when His breath releases light, it also transforms countless sentient beings. Buddha's aura can transform living beings, so it is said: "All sentient beings, possessing Buddha nature, possessing Buddha nature."

As a human being, there are countless microorganisms in every breath we take. When the microorganisms in our breath breathe, they also transform into countless other sentient beings. Therefore, when beings transformed by Buddha practice, they will become Buddhas; As for living beings transformed by living beings, although they are a little different, they will one day become Buddhas.

Animals can also transform into other living beings because they also have respiration. In each of their breaths are hidden countless microorganisms, which, when supported, will transform into other species of living beings; If there is no supporting condition, transformation cannot take place.

In our body there are countless types of germs, each germ is a living being. Within each microbe there are countless other superbugs; really: "There is no need to be born, to transform infinitely!"

Think about it, big beings can change big, small beings can change small, each in its own way. Therefore, there are countless living beings in the world, and the more they proliferate, the more they multiply. Multiply until the world cannot contain it anymore, then the world will be destroyed. However, when this world is destroyed, another world is created. There are always beings that arise or create karma and receive retribution; then in such a crazy, confused circle.

Sentient beings do not want enlightenment, and even think that they are pure and wise; Therefore, Trung Dung book says: "The human race writes the remaining knowledge, the children's area is filled with the province of the ancients, and the children's desert is the wisdom of the wild. Meaning: "A person thinks he is wise. Even when he is pushed into the pit, he doesn't know he needs to get out!" So, let's ask if this wisdom is stupidity?

Living beings need to eat to live. Like a trained dolphin that knows how to jump, how to dance, and how to obey; That's because it wants to eat! When given food, he will do as he is told, do whatever he says. Because of money, beauty, fame, eating, drinking, sleeping, and the five desires, I'm crazy and confused, not knowing how to turn back home. Then on such a dangerous road, the farther I ran from home, the farther I got, the more lost I became, adrift in the sea of life and death without knowing how to turn back to the shore. How pitiful!

If living beings do not love money, they will also love beauty; It is these two desires that make everyone reel, unable to escape. If not, then indulge in eating, drinking, fame, or sleeping. Those are the delusions of sentient beings. Because of false attachments, we cannot break the cycle of confusion and confusion. Whoever understands the infatuation and lets it go can be free!

79. WHAT IS leaving the home life?

(Van Buddha Thanh September 1, 1982)

Although the Buddha was a Crown Prince of India, he was deeply bored with worldly wealth, so he wanted to leave the throne to leave the home life to practice Buddhism. He also wanted to make all sentient beings know that all dharmas of the world are illusions.

Where did this world come from? It is created by sentient beings' delusions, and in the future it will also be destroyed by sentient beings' delusions; So there is a sentence: Like a marketer, like a marketer. (As long as there is a cause, there is an effect.)

In the world, everything is impermanence and decay. Bodhisattva was bored with worldly dharma, Buddha was even more estranged from worldly dharma. He did not develop a defiled heart and attachment to that dharma. He forever cut off worldly craving and desire. What people are greedy for, Buddha is not greedy for, what people love, Buddha is not fond of, because he has no desire, so he has no afflictions.

Where does the affliction we have now come from? It is born from greed and love! If we are not greedy, we do not have selfishness, if we do not have selfishness, we do not have afflictions.

Why should I be greedy? Because we are influenced by thoughts of desire, causing us to develop craving. If there is craving that cannot be satisfied, afflictions will arise; If there is affliction, there will be madness; If there is chaos, there will be pollution. Now, when we practice purity, we must do something to eliminate all kinds of pollution.

Buddha always sought to benefit sentient beings. While in the royal palace, Buddha was not greedy for all kinds of glory and wealth; When leaving the home life, he put aside all the majesty of worldly people and did not argue with others, so he attained the Samadhi of Non-Controversy:

"Vietnamese victory betrays the heart,

The Dao of Data is infinitely similar,

It is convenient to give birth to the four characteristics of the mind,

Such as having attained Samadhi?"

Translated as:

"Fighting is about winning or losing,

Going against the Tao,

Causes the birth of four forms,

How can I attain Samadhi?"

Buddha abides in the Dharma of Non-Contestation. He fulfilled the vow he made in the past, complete with immeasurable merits. He uses the light of Great Wisdom to eliminate all ignorance in the world, and destroy all darkness of ignorance. He is the supreme field of blessings of sentient beings in the world, always praising the merits of all Buddhas in the ten directions and three times for sentient beings, causing sentient beings to plant blessings, pray for wisdom, and cultivate all good roots in the Three Jewels. Buddha used his eyes of wisdom to see all true morality, then praised the merit of leaving the home life for the sake of sentient beings.

"leaving the home life" is from the Three Realms (the Desire Realm, the Form Realm and the Formless Realm), and is also from the Worldly Family. "Secular" is the home of people; Once you leave the house of other people, it means you no longer think like other people.

"leaving the home life" It also means coming out of the house of afflictions. We, every single person in this world, are in a house of troubles. When I'm angry, I feel that eating any delicious food has no taste at all, so when I leave the home life, I want to leave the house of troubles.

"leaving the home life" It also means leaving the Ignorance family. "Ignorance" That means you don't have a clear understanding, you don't understand everything, you do everything crazy. Therefore, we must get out of the house of ignorance.

Leaving the home life is also due to many different reasons. Like in China, there are many people who are old and have no relatives to rely on, so they leave the home life to have someone take care of them easily in the future. Some people leave the home life due to pressing circumstances; Or because they broke the law or killed someone, they wanted to change their name, change their identity, change their face, and leave the home life so that the king wouldn't hunt them anymore. Some people find it difficult to raise, so their families decide to give it to the temple. Those are the three types of people leaving the home life, whether they can practice or not is unknown; Maybe they can practice, but maybe they can't!

There are also righteous people who, because of the matter of life and death, develop Bodhi mind, leave the home life. People leaving the home life like that, if they never change their mind, are truly practicing. Because of suffering, thinking about the problem of life and death, they develop great Bodhi mind, and practice according to Buddha's teachings.

So leaving the home life has many different moods and situations. However, after leaving the home life, do not make mistakes but become pure, stay away from all sins, restore your own pure mind, forever leave the house of the Three Realms, leave the house of Defilements, leave the house of Ignorance, leave the house of Worldliness.

Someone asked: Why is there no female Buddha?

Answer: It's not that there are no female Buddhas. Also. In the Lotus Sutra, it is very clearly said that after the Dragon Lady donated the pearl, she immediately became a Buddha. Dragon Lady was a girl who offered pearls to Buddha. After offering, she immediately became Buddha. This proves that women also become Buddhas, but very rarely.

As for the issue of why being a man or why being a woman is a matter of preference. Anyone who has the idea of wanting to be a girl will become a girl; if they have the idea of wanting to be a man, they will become a man in the future. That is the karma that you create yourself, receive the results yourself, and transform according to karma. However, there are also people who have the ability to control their own karma. They are not swayed by the realm, but on the contrary, they can rotate the universe, change their karma and control themselves.

If we depend on karma, we have no ability to control it. If we know how to transfer karma, it means we have the ability to control it. Why does Bodhisattva make vows? It is to control the flow of karma. They use great vows as a pillar, thus turning karma around. Therefore, it is said that they can transfer karma but karma cannot transfer them; They can change realms but realms cannot change them; They can transfer retribution but retribution cannot transfer them!

Actually, it is possible to control karma, but one must have wisdom. If we are just delusional, ignorant, and specialize in doing crazy things, then we cannot control it.

Ask them: "Why do you want to do crazy things?" You replied: "Don't know." Because you don't know, just follow karma!

Therefore, it is not that women are incapable of becoming Buddhas, nor is it that Buddha is positive and demons are negative. However, it can also be said that Buddha is pure yang, demons are pure yin, and humans are half yang and half yin!

It's not that men are completely positive and women are completely negative! If it is true that a man is completely positive, then there is no need to marry a woman, and if a woman is completely yin, then there is no need to marry a man. Because after getting married, it will become half yin and half yang, no longer pure yin or pure yang.

Practicing practice means cultivating to the point of no-outflow, that is, to the place of pure yang. Male is yang but within yang there is yin; Female is yin but within yin there is yang. Therefore, after getting married, you have the ability to have children because yin and yang combine to transform. That is a relative realm.

It's not that male is completely yang or female is necessarily completely yin. In the I Ching it is said: "One yin and one yang, the Way. Thien yin and yang, because of the defect."

"Heaven" It means extreme, if the sky is yin or yang, there will be illness, which means it is wrong. If there is no extreme, it is called Central, if there is no change, it is called Dung; That is the principle of Trung Dung. Therefore, men should not think that they are completely positive, because if so, why would they want to get married? Because when a man gets married, there is yin in the yang, and when a woman gets married, there is yang in the yin; It's a matter of yin and yang exchanging.

Now what is called "person"? "Person" just a fake name. I have said many times before that in the beginning the word "human" coined to refer to humans. If we initially use the word "dog," Now I call humans "dogs". already! So if you use it for a long time, it becomes a habit, the word "person" it's just a name.

Now comes the sentence, "One yin, one yang, one cause," meaning one yin and one yang is a person. In yang there is yin, in yin there is yang; In winter there is a hidden summer, just as in summer there is also a hidden winter. During winter, at some point yang will be born (winter solstice); and during the summer, at some point a yin (summer solstice) will be born. A year is the transformation of yin and yang. When yin reaches its extreme it becomes yang, when yang reaches its extreme it becomes yin. Therefore, people are born as positive, die as negative, it is the same principle.

We call ourselves "human"; but in the beginning if we called humans "chickens," then the word "chicken" If you get used to it, no one will think it's strange anymore. It's like naming a baby "puppy"; When it grows up, if someone calls you "puppy" then it knows it's calling its name. It's just a name, and just a fake name. People with the surname Truong say they are surnamed Truong. Ask him why his last name is Truong; then replied that it was because their father was Truong. Ask your grandfather what they are; He replied that his last name was Truong. Ask your great-grandparents, great-grandparents, what their ancestors are and where they come from; At the end of the day, that guy still doesn't know what his ancestor's last name is, because it's just a fake name!

Therefore, don't be attached, don't say I'm like that or I'm like that. Because no matter what you say, there is an "I" In that, there is selfishness. When there is selfishness, there is suffering. If there is no "I" There's no selfishness, so what's the problem?

Why do people get angry? It's because you think that other people are not good to you, despise you, treat you badly, and then get angry. But if they do something that benefits me, I'm happy. It's all because of ignorance that makes you move your mind!

80. Eating meat is the source of disaster!

(Van Buddha Thanh September 19, 1982)

Buddhism has three eras: the True Dharma, the Immortal Dharma, and the End of the Dharma. That is caused by the karma of sentient beings.

During the Dharma, people receive very great and rich blessings, and their wisdom is also very high. On land, water is like milk, very nutritious, and water is good everywhere. By the time of the Dharma Statue, drinking water had lost its nutrients. Currently, during the End of Dharma era, water no longer has nutrients, on the contrary, it is mixed with all kinds of poisons. Someone said: "We drink water that has been poisoned." However, the water is still toxic, there is no way to get rid of it.

In the world, toxic substances are increasing day by day, causing air pollution. Because people use too much poison, the poison gradually seeps into the human body, then undergoes changes in the body. When we exhale, the poison returns back into the air. Currently, the void is filled with poisonous gas.

We know that atomic bombs and hydrogen bombs are the most dangerous things, but those things are worse than the poisonous gas released from our mouths. Therefore, this world is becoming more and more dangerous. Because of being embalmed by that toxic gas, every day people are like "living in a drunken state, dying in a dream". so. Eating, gambling, drinking, cheating, stealing, there is nothing bad that they don't know how to do. That is an extremely toxic, extremely dangerous situation.

Now, if we want the world to eliminate all toxins, what measures must be taken? That means you must be vegetarian, don't eat meat! If you are vegetarian, the toxins will be reduced. If you want this world to be completely free of poison, then everyone should stop eating meat and only be vegetarian. Because there is poison in meat, and this poison is very subtle, even if you eat it, you will not realize that it is poisonous. However, slowly you will be exposed to the meat's poison, so powerful that no medicine can save you, because the meat contains very deep resentment. That's why the ancients said:

"Thousands of years of wandering,

Deep resentment comes from a sea of hatred and difficulty.

Desire to know the world's superior swords and warriors,

Ignore the disciples and sell your voice."

Translated as:

"Thousands of years of resentment are filled with soup, resentment is as deep as the ocean, hatred is hard to dissolve. If you want to know why there is war, listen to the slaughterhouse, at midnight!"

The piece of meat in the bowl of soup may be small, but it actually contains hatred as deep as the ocean. People fight with people, one family fights with another, one country tears apart another, one earth destroys another; What causes such war is caused by eating meat. All the disasters of swords, water, fire, and epidemics are caused by eating meat. If you want to understand morality, go to the butcher's house at midnight and listen: Listen to the painful roar of a pig being stabbed with blood, listen to the angry cry of a buffalo or goat being killed.

In short, any animal that is killed will cry and moan. When it cries, it releases toxic gas. One side releases toxic gas, the other side cries and says: "Very good! You guys kill me now, in the future I will kill you back. This debt can never be wiped away! You kill me, I'll kill you back, you eat me, I'll eat you back!" Because of such resentment and hatred, all kinds of disasters are created.

If people become vegetarian, those injustices will be eliminated, many swords will become velvet, and danger will become auspicious. Therefore, we must find a way to save the coming Dharma Ending Age!
